item.title: Unfinished entrance to Laynes Court, formerly part of Blacklaines Farm, 23rd November
item.description:
The site of 4 barn conversions completed by Scottsdale Developments still has no completed access. The private courtyard has been finished for over a year, and all properties have been occupied for a year, but the road has not been finished up to the courtyard boundary. The ramp down from the courtyard is sufficiently steep that it 'tips' an emerging vehicle onto the carriageway and this has caused several near-misses. On entering the courtyard from the lane, the ramp is difficult to encounter smoothly, which is likely to cause incidents and suspension damage. The developer left the site a year ago, and I am not even sure whether the company remains trading.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Birdlip Road, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet
